top_reply.author: @demolition3612
top_reply.text:
They never claimed directly that detail, but people who dont understand the technology wont know what they meant. The sound waves can have variations in time of arrival that when translated to position analysis are less than an atom apart, aka the position coordinates are not gridlocked into atomic integers and are continuous for all intents and purposes. Despite the resolution not being that stupidly high.

They also said in the text that it was accurate to half a millimeter, the comment about atomic scale was fluff based on misinterpreted technical details.

top_comments.text: Real device, real ultrasound, but the "atomic resolution" everyone's arguing about is from a viral thread, not Midjourney. Their actual claim is sub-millimetre, MRI-like. Real engineering, real motive, no clinical proof yet.
